title: Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.14605v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. translated_title: 多模态大语言模型遗忘中知识遗忘与拒绝学习的解耦
translated_abstract: 当前对多模态遗忘的评估通常只关注模型是否停止输出目标信息。然而，这种表面化的标准掩盖了两种关键的失败模式。其一，知识抑制技术常常引发虚构，导致模型对被遗忘对象产生幻觉式的事实描述。其二，拒绝训练仅仅改变了可观察的行为，并未抹除潜在的知识；这类模型可能拒绝回答开放式提问，但在多项选择题探测下仍能识别出正确答案。为克服这些局限，我们提出了遗忘感知自蒸馏（Forget-Aware Self-Distillation, FASD）。该方法旨在实现“诚实的无知”，即模型真正丢失目标知识并学会承认其缺失的状态。FASD将这两个目标分离到两个互补的通道中：行为通道从模型自身一个被“无知提示”的副本中蒸馏出恰当的拒绝行为。至关重要的是，目标词元……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出遗忘感知自蒸馏（FASD）方法，通过将拒绝行为学习与知识真正遗忘解耦为两个互补通道，使多模态大语言模型在遗忘中实现“诚实的无知”，同时避免知识抑制引发的虚构和仅流于表面的虚假拒绝。
en_tdlr: Proposes Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD), which decouples refusal behavior learning from genuine knowledge erasure into two complementary channels, enabling "honest ignorance" in MLLM unlearning while avoiding confabulation and superficial refusal.
